mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_record (scope, request_key, request_hash) VALUES (#{scope}, #{requestKey,jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{requestHash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_hash = request_hash
mapper.select: SELECT id, scope, request_key, request_hash, http_status, response_body, create_time, update_time FROM idempotency_record WHERE scope = #{scope} AND request_key = #{requestKey,jdbcType=VARBINARY} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_record SET http_status = #{httpStatus}, response_body = #{responseBody} WHERE id = #{id}
